item.text: I’ll first locate and inspect the ECG image, then describe the rhythm and key abnormalities. I can offer a likely interpretation, but an ECG alone—especially without symptoms, vitals, and prior tracings—cannot safely establish a definitive diagnosis.

Please upload the ECG image—the tracing isn’t available in the message or workspace. Ideally include all 12 leads, calibration marks, and the printed rhythm strip.

Also provide age, symptoms, heart rate, and any prior ECG if available. If the patient has chest pain, severe breathlessness, fainting, or marked weakness, seek emergency care now rather than waiting for an online interpretation.
